exposure: IUD insertion timing (immediate vs. mediate puerperium)
Type of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: Patients who had a TCU-380 copper IUD placed during the puerperal period, divided into immediate and mediate insertion groups.
finding: The total rate of IUD expulsions was 28.8%, and there was no significant association between IUD expulsion and the timing of insertion (immediate vs. mediate puerperium).
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was a significant predictor for IUD expulsion, being four times more likely to be associated with expulsion inserted in the puerperal period than cesarean section.
